name: AppsFlyer SDK
plain: A third-party SDK that attributes installs, runs deep links, and sends events to ad networks.
meaning: Sees device IDs, IP, user agent, in-app events for every customer app, and uses fraud and cohort tools. OneLink handles deferred deep links.

android.permission: INTERNET, ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE; AD_ID for GAID; Install Referrer library
android.store_policy: Data safety must list SDK data; Families: certified ad SDK rules
android.api_surface: MMP SDK + Play Install Referrer + GAID
android.note: Uses Install Referrer and GAID; collects IP and OS data.

ios.permission: NSUserTrackingUsageDescription if IDFA used; privacy manifest from SDK
ios.store_policy: Privacy manifest and signature required for listed SDKs; ATT 5.1.2(i)
ios.note: Uses SKAN, AAK and IDFA when allowed; on iOS can run probabilistic modeling per vendor docs for some users.

data.metric: Install, session and event records tied to an MMP ID

fields.name: device ID
fields.range: GAID, IDFA or IDFV, MMP-specific ID

limits.headline: Can link your install to an ad and watch what you do in the app
limits.user_action: Nothing. It starts when the app opens, after you tapped an ad and installed
can: Match an install to an ad using the install referrer and Google ad ID
Collect device IDs, IP address and app events across its customers' apps
Open the right screen after install with a link
cannot: Use the iPhone ad ID until you allow tracking
Skip Apple's delayed reports for people who said no
See what you do in apps that do not use its tool
limits.differs: Android uses the install referrer and ad ID. iPhone uses Apple's reports and the ID only if allowed.

story.what_it_is: A popular install tracking SDK that credits installs to ads, runs deep links and shares events with ad networks.
story.for_you: You never see it. If you clicked an ad, it quietly tells the app company which one, and it can take you to the right page after install.
story.for_makers: AppsFlyer sees device IDs, IP, user agent and in app events across thousands of apps, and offers fraud and cohort tools. Its OneLink product handles links that survive an install.

use_cases.example: A mobile game sees which TikTok ad brought the most spenders and moves its budget there.
A shopping app uses OneLink so a shared link opens a product, even after install.
An ad network sends events to AppsFlyer so the advertiser can compare it with others.
Its fraud suite blocks fake installs and bot clicks before the advertiser pays.
A ride app credits a first ride to the referral link that a friend shared.
A team builds groups of users who bought in week one and sends them to ad networks.

risks: Sees activity across many customer apps
story.android_note: Reads the Google advertising ID and the Play install referrer.
story.ios_note: Uses SKAN, AdAttributionKit and the IDFA only with consent.

technical_bounds: Data flows to the vendor's cloud
Needs ATT for IDFA matching on iOS
Privacy manifest and required reasons apply

legit_uses: Attribution, fraud detection, deep links, ROAS

history.change: MMPs shift to SKAN and consent-gated IDFA for iOS
Privacy manifests and signatures required for the SDK
Privacy Sandbox wind-down: Install Referrer plus GAID remain the Android core
